import java.util.Scanner;

public class Main {
    static final long inf = 17446744073709551616L;
    static long mod, n, k;
    static long[][] dp = new long[19][300005];
    static long[] fac = new long[300005];
    static long[] inv = new long[300005];

    static long qpow(long a, long b) {
        long res = 1L;
        long tp = a;
        while (b > 0) {
            if ((b & 1L) == 1L) {
                res = (res * tp) % mod;
            }
            tp = (tp * tp) % mod;
            b >>= 1;
        }
        return res;
    }

    static long cal(int a, int b) {
        return (((fac[a] * inv[b]) % mod) * inv[a - b]) % mod;
    }

    static long calc() {
        int i, j, l;
        fac[0] = 1L;
        long ti = Math.max(n, k);
        for (i = 1; i <= ti; i++) {
            fac[i] = (fac[i - 1] * i) % mod;
        }
        inv[(int) ti] = qpow(fac[(int) ti], mod - 2);
        for (i = (int) ti - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
            inv[i] = (inv[i + 1] * (i + 1)) % mod;
        }
        for (i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
            dp[1][i] = inv[i];
        }
        long ans = (dp[1][(int) n] * cal(k, 1)) % mod;
        int t = Math.min(18, (int) k);
        for (i = 2; i <= t; i++) {
            for (j = (int) n; j > 0; j = (j - 1) & (int) n) {
                if (dp[i - 1][j] == 0) continue;
                int r = (int) (n ^ j);
                for (l = r; l > j; l = (l - 1) & r) {
                    dp[i][j ^ l] += dp[i - 1][j] * inv[l];
                    if (dp[i][j ^ l] > inf) dp[i][j ^ l] %= mod;
                }
            }
            for (j = (int) n; j > 0; j = (j - 1) & (int) n) {
                if (dp[i][j] >= mod) dp[i][j] %= mod;
            }
            long res = (dp[i][(int) n] * cal(k, i)) % mod;
            res = (res * fac[i]) % mod;
            ans = (ans + res >= mod) ? ans + res - mod : ans + res;
        }
        ans = (ans * fac[(int) n]) % mod;
        return ans;
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        n = sc.nextLong();
        k = sc.nextLong();
        mod = sc.nextLong();
        long ans = qpow(k, n);
        if (n % 2 == 0) {
            long temp = calc();
            ans = (ans - temp + mod) % mod;
        }
        System.out.println(ans);
        sc.close();
    }
}
